# Frozen port task v1

Implement `port.ts` with an exported pure `evaluate(input: unknown)` function. Reproduce the behavior in `contract.json` and `public-cases.json`. Use TypeScript only, no dependencies, file IO, network, subprocesses, or imports. Return JSON-serializable values. Never mutate input. Treat only finite safe integer JavaScript numbers as integers. Validate fields in canonical order; semantic range errors and type errors both participate in that order. For keyset errors return field `$` before checking fields. A low >= high error comes after all individual field checks. Preserve no unrelated keys in responses. Use exactly the listed success keys and failure shape. Implementation will be compiled under TypeScript strict mode and run against unseen oracle-derived cases. Create only `port.ts` in the working directory. Do not use external tools beyond reading these supplied files and writing the implementation.
